Subject: Clarify CSA/CAIQ sample set and evidence handoff for Aurora Bio

Hi Liam / Aurora security team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — appreciated the deep-dive on scope. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass CAIQ-to-control crosswalk for Redwood that maps our standard attestations and typical evidence artifacts. This is a working file so expect a couple of edits as we align samples to your control list.

As next steps I propose:
- We deliver a compact sample bundle (representative logs + runbook excerpts + key rotation summary) by EOD Thursday (10/22).
- You confirm the specific CAIQ control IDs you want sampled (we highlighted a suggested set in column D of the attached).
- If you need encrypted bucket proofs or HSM screenshots, call that out and we’ll include masked artifacts.

Two quick clarifications:
1) We prioritize runtime telemetry, key management, and tenancy isolation controls for production deployments — if you have a narrower set, point us to it and we’ll trim.
2) For certain artifacts (full audit logs, CSR files) we will provide redacted samples via secure ShareLink rather than raw attachments.

Attachments: redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx (working crosswalk)

CCing Kim and Priyom to own the evidence upload lanes.

Best,

Marissa Cole

Marissa —

Thanks for the crosswalk. A few quick items from our side after an internal review:

- We’d like samples for the following CAIQ IDs only: CCM-03 (Key Management), CCM-07 (Data Encryption), CCM-12 (Identity & Access), CCM-18 (Logging & Monitoring). If you can confirm those map cleanly to your rows it’ll save cycles.
- For key management, please include proof of KMS rotation (dates and key IDs). A redacted KMS policy and a screenshot of rotation history is fine.
- For logging we’ll need a 72-hour rolling sample (redacted) and a short explanation of retention policy.

Also — do you have a recent SOC 2 Type II report we can reference? A PDF link would be perfect; if it’s under NDA we can sign an NDA but prefer to get the high-level report first.

If possible, could you push the sample bundle to a secure ShareLink and send the link to security@aurorabio.com? We’d like the artifacts in place for our auditor kickoff the week of 10/26.

Thanks,
Liam

Thanks for the specific CAIQ IDs. We’ll align the crosswalk rows CCM-03/07/12/18 to your requested samples and send a compact bundle via secure ShareLink by end of day Thursday (10/22) as discussed.

Quick answers to your asks:
- SOC 2: We can share the Redwood SOC 2 Type II (2026 Q2) executive summary publicly; full report available under NDA. Here’s the exec summary link: https://redwood.com/soc2/report-2026Q2.pdf
- KMS rotation proof: attaching a short rotation summary (kms-rotation-summary.txt) and a masked screenshot will be uploaded to the ShareLink.
- Logs: we will provide a 72-hour redacted telemetry sample (gzip) and a short retention note in the runbook extract.

I’ve attached the Redwood CSI runbook excerpt that explains our telemetry pipeline and log retention/aggregation. Priyom — can you confirm storage location and expected upload time (S3 ShareLink + expiry 7 days)?

Marissa
